sloka: एवम् उक्तः तथा तेन वसिष्ठो जपताम् वरः ।आजुहाव ततः प्रीतः कल्माषीम् धूत कल्मषः ॥१-५२-२०॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tathā tena vasiṣṭho japatām varaḥ ।ājuhāva tataḥ prītaḥ kalmāṣīm dhūta kalmaṣaḥ ॥1-52-20॥

translations.english: Vasishta who was highly brilliant the greatest among those who meditate (on Brahman) and free from sins was pleased. Thereafter he called the speckled cow (Kamadhenu):
